notes.note: Whitfield had his second 130+ in the last three weeks with 33 disposals and 9 marks.
Whitfield had a great game with 26 disposals and 7 marks. In wet conditions he was one of just three Giants to hit 100.

Whitfield was everywhere early with a. big first quarter. He then backed that up with a big second half. Ending with 7 tackles and 29 disposals it was another big game for him and his best score of the season.
Whitfield took 11 marks and had 26 touches but 5 clangers and just 1 of his possessions contested is why his game didn't translate into a big score.
Whitfield returned from his concussion and had 23 disposals with 82% efficiency. He was a great hold for those that were able to.

Whitfield left the game in the second term with concussion and didn't return after half time. This means he is going to miss next week's game so make sure you have some bench cover. Word is that he should only miss one.
Whitfield was quiet in the second term but with 47 in the first and 35 in the third he top scored for the Giants from his 33 disposals.

Whitfield was one of the popular Roberts replacements and he managed 25 disposals this week in a game that didn't see many players over 100. He went forward in the last quarter and had just 2 points after what was looking like a good score.
Whitfield just missed the ton but was great for his 31 disposals. This is three under 100 in a row but the last two have been 90+
Whitfield played after missing last week with a bit of a hamstring complaint. 26 disposals and 10 marks for him which delivered his third lowest score of the season.

Whitfield was a late out with Hamstring Awareness. Watch the injury reports to see how bad it is. Just beware that he has the bye the following week so don't be surprised if he gets rested again this week.
Whitfield was tagged by Murdock this week and really struggled early before making his way to 21 disposals at 85%. His lowest since opening round.
Whitfield was under a cloud after leaving training early during the week but he looked fine with a huge game including 26 kicks 9 handballs and 7 marks. His best score this season.
Whitfield was the best for the Giants with his 30 disposals coming at 80%. He is one of the ones you should be targeting as he has the good bye.
Whitfield was the best scorer for the Giants and he has been on quite a run over the last four games. If you are shopping for a defender he is certainly one to consider.
29 touches at 80% for Whitfield. His third over 100 in a row and he is really starting to hit some great form. One you must consider for your side.
Whitfield had 31 disposals at 87% and he looks strong again this season and will be right up there as someone to look at as we move into upgrades.
Whitfield was the top scoring Giant thanks to 39 disposals at 87%. With Ash also scoring well it shows us that they can both have big games together which is a good sign.
Whitfield finished with the 28 disposals. An improvement on last week for him and he isn't one to worry about at the moment as his price will continue to reduce for now.
Whitfield got plenty of the footy on the outside with just 3 of his disposals being contested. Don't panic trade him as this should be an anomaly for him and the Giants.
For those considering Whitfield he didn't do anything to tell us we shouldn't pick him.
